system.description: On first gaining this, gain one Patron of your choice with their Urge and Blessing and a 6-section Favour clock starting with 2 filled. Each acquisition grants two Patron Boons of your choice; at most half (rounded up) of your total Boons may be active at once, chosen at rest or by erasing one Favour section to swap as an action during a scene.
